svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Outer pan: 1 mm aluminium, 1200 x 1000 x 250, open at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bottom, corners folded and riveted.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inner pan: 1 mm aluminium, 1120 x 920 x 210, open at the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fill the 40 mm gap at the top and sides with mineral wool slab;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: close the bottom edge with a riveted U-channel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit hardwood blocks in the wool at the four handle standoffs and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the inlet, so bolts clamp on wood, not on wool.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inlet hole: 30.6 through both skins, centred across, 150 in from

svg.text: Check: the hood lies flat on a floor; no wool shows.
